scope: Native reason encoding, descriptor/class tables, owned error-value expansion and atomic binary error preparation. Existing admitted instruction/BIF failures produce expanded terminal values. Not handle_error, stacktrace capture/symbolization, catch/unwind, throw promotion, exit signals, logging or additional native effects.
adaptations: exception.h retains native error.h class/index/flag masks, fresh codes, primary/native extraction and TRAP identity with LB_ names. Immutable error_atom and exception_tag tables preserve native ordering. Encodings/tables grant no effect authority. The representation checker extracts upstream macros and checks both configurations and source table identities.

Process freason is now a native Uint scalar, not an Eterm root. GC and private-alias scanning visit the new owned exception_value term instead. Existing BIF and generated instruction boundaries set native encoded reasons; the compatibility category getter decodes the shorthand atom. No second error/runtime implementation or legacy switch remains.

expand_error_value retains primary passthrough, all ten tuple-valued shorthand cases and ordinary atom descriptors. The owned adaptation roots the incoming value, reserves three words plus pending credit fallibly, and publishes last. PANIC/internal-error codes are refused rather than terminating the host. Arglist unwrapping and throw promotion are not performed by this helper, matching its position below native handle_error preparation.

The admitted executor materializes terminal error values before exposing EXCEPTION; expansion OOM is infrastructure NO_MEMORY. Unsupported exception classes/action flags do not enter a partial handle_error. Original code/flags are retained, including pending SAVETRACE; no claim that a trace was captured or full native exception handling completed. Nonextended pending values are cleared after expansion; extended payloads remain owned separately from the expanded value.

lb_binary_error_prepare accepts only bare native BADARG/SYSTEM_LIMIT, builds the existing payload with its explicit root, then infallibly publishes fvalue and reason|EXF_HAS_EXT_INFO. Failure preserves pending fields. Preparation does not raise, execute a catch or fabricate a stacktrace. The pure binary sizing result continues to classify reasons as atoms; callers must explicitly select the corresponding encoded reason at this boundary.

Tests cover 23 code/table entries and flag combinations, malformed codes, all value-expansion branches, scalar exit/throw codes across real GC (not guest exit/throw execution), borrowed binary operands through allocation failure/retry and atomic metadata replacement. Existing badmatch/case/function-clause/decimal-BIF failures execute real BEAM, publish native values, survive exception-root-only GC, exact comparison, flat-copy and source destruction, and retry in the same space after expansion OOM. Four value vectors match a separate stock driver; that driver is never admitted. Historical alias-root coverage now uses the real exception_value root instead of the former term-valued freason.
